components.name: Timer Icon
components.description: Signature square game icon: dimmed with a dark sweep and white countdown while down; blinks yellow when it returns.
components.html: 2:41
components.css: .ds-timer-row { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 12px; background: var(--card, #12151c); } .ds-timer { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; overflow: hidden; background: #191d26; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); font-family: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-timer-art { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f7d04a, #e07b20 60%, #6b2a10); } .ds-timer-down .ds-timer-art { filter: brightness(0.75) grayscale(0.7); } .ds-timer-sweep { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: conic-gradient(rgb(5 6 9 / 0.78) 230deg, rgb(5 6 9 / 0.3) 0); } .ds-timer-num { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.95); } .ds-timer-up { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f2e94e; animation: ds-blink-trail 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) infinite; } .ds-timer-up::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #f2e94e; mix-blend-mode: screen; animation: ds-blink-pop 450ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) infinite both; } @keyframes ds-blink-pop { 0% { opacity: 0.95; transform: scale(1.25); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1); } } @keyframes ds-blink-trail { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f2e94e, -7px 0 0 -2px rgb(242 233 78 / 0.55), -13px 0 0 -4px rgb(242 233 78 / 0.3); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f2e94e, 0 0 0 0 rgb(242 233 78 / 0), 0 0 0 0 rgb(242 233 78 / 0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-timer-up, .ds-timer-up::after { animation: none; } .ds-timer-up::after { opacity: 0; } }

components.css: .ds-badges { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; background: #0b0d12; } .ds-badge { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 6px; font-family: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-badge-live { color: #f2e94e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(242 233 78 / 0.5); } .ds-badge-live .ds-badge-dot { background: #f2e94e; animation: ds-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite; } .ds-badge-off { color: #9aa0ac; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); } .ds-badge-off .ds-badge-dot { background: #9aa0ac; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.5; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-badge-live .ds-badge-dot { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The app is named after Flash, so it behaves like one: things that come back blink. The world is a near-black night with hard-edged, almost square panels and a single electric yellow that carries exactly one meaning: it's up. Live status, the brand streaks, and a spell returning are yellow; everything else stays neutral grey-white so that the yellow, when it appears, reads in a fraction of a second over a busy game map.

Density is high and deliberate. The main window is 420px wide and the overlay is a tiny click-through strip of square icons, so every element earns its pixels: tight 4px gaps between icons, condensed type, tabular numerals for every number. Cooldown state is shown by subtraction, not addition: a down icon is dimmed and desaturated with a dark sweep wedge and a plain white countdown, and the reward is the blink when it returns.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, slightly lifted panels, hairline white borders.
One accent, Flash yellow, used only for "up" (live, brand, returning spell).
Square geometry: 2px corners at most, many surfaces fully square.
Barlow Semi Condensed throughout, tabular numerals globally.
Signature motion: the blink (pop plus two yellow afterimages, then a 3s yellow ring).

rules.name: The It's-Up Rule
rules.body: Yellow means "up" and nothing else: live, brand, a spell returning, and the focus ring. Never put it on headings, labels, decorative numbers or selection states; dilution kills the signal.

rules.name: The Dim-Not-Paint Rule
rules.body: Cooldown is shown by dimming the icon (brightness 75%, grayscale 70%) under a dark conic sweep, with a white countdown. Never tint down-state icons a color.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number is tabular (set globally on the body). Countdowns must not jitter as they tick.

rules.name: The One Frame Rule
rules.body: Panels get the frame, not a heavier shadow or a colored border. Depth comes from tone and the top-edge streak.

dos: Do keep Flash Yellow to "up" meanings: live, brand streaks, the blink, focus.
Do frame every panel with the Hairline border and the yellow top-edge streak.
Do show cooldown by dimming the icon with the dark sweep and a white countdown.
Do use tabular numerals for every number.
Do keep corners square or at 2px.
Do honor reduced motion: blink and pulses collapse to static state (the ring, the dot).
donts: Don't put yellow on headings, section labels, step numbers or selected states.
Don't tint cooldown icons or countdowns a color; the countdown is white.
Don't add rounded cards, heavy shadows or colored borders; the overlay lift is the only drop shadow.
Don't add a second accent color or a light theme; there is one theme.
